summary: This note covers the 2017 Major League Baseball All-Star Game, the 88th edition of the event. The Miami Marlins hosted it at Marlins Park on July 11, 2017, and Fox televised it nationally. The game was notable because its outcome no longer decided World Series home-field advantage, which instead went to the team with the better regular-season record.
one_line: The 88th MLB All-Star Game, hosted by the Miami Marlins at Marlins Park on July 11, 2017.
key_facts: The 2017 Major League Baseball All-Star Game was the 88th edition of the Major League Baseball All-Star Game.
The game was hosted by the Miami Marlins and played at Marlins Park on July 11, 2017.
The game was televised nationally by Fox.
It was the first All-Star Game since 2002 whose outcome did not determine home-field advantage for the World Series.
Home-field advantage for the World Series went to the team with the better regular-season record instead.
Major League Baseball Commissioner Rob Manfred announced the Marlins as hosts on February 10, 2015.
The 2017 game was the Marlins' first time hosting the All-Star Game.
The Tampa Bay Rays were the only MLB franchise that had not hosted an All-Star Game at the time.
